name: Diff security skimmer
why: Ranks security risks in only the changed lines of a pull request, a quick first pass before the full secure code review.

name: Threat list maker
why: Turns a description of how an app works into ranked likely attacks with one way to reduce each, a fast start for the threat model prompt.

name: Weekly dependency and security sweep
why: Tracks what is new, open or fixed in dependencies each week with an upgrade order, a lighter cadence of the monthly sweep.

name: Find leaked keys, secure them and check your live site
why: Finds leaked keys, plans rotation and moves secrets to safe storage, and stops if ownership of the live site cannot be confirmed.

name: Fix API security gaps with tests and a pull request
why: Fixes sign-in, access and input gaps in API code with a test for each fix, the same shape as the code review findings.

name: Prepare a vendor security questionnaire response
why: Drafts sourced questionnaire answers with an evidence index and open questions, a companion to the customer review workflow.

name: Quarterly compliance readiness keeper
why: Checks SOC 2, ISO 27001 or GDPR readiness each quarter, for clients whose customers ask for a framework beyond ASVS.

name: Connect Code to Supabase coding prompt
why: Connects an app to Supabase with scoped access and safe secrets, a safe pattern to point developers to.

name: Sign-in security checker
why: Ranks gaps in how staff and customers sign in to a store and drafts a password and second-step policy.

name: Turn an API into a safe, installable MCP server
why: Builds an MCP server with sign-in and a security check, useful when a client's app exposes tools to AI agents.
